verdict.rationale: Framer's docs say every site change is saved automatically and any version can be restored in seconds. Branching lets designers explore and merge ideas without touching the main project. That covers the restore part of the story, but there is no evidence for naming milestones or comparing versions side by side. Missing for 10: named milestones/versions, a version diff or compare view, independent or hands-on corroboration of version history.
